findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "share_family_context" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Sends one email from SATCoach (hello@satcoach.ai) to a parent, with a link to set up SATCoach for their child, carrying what you already know about the child's …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: skill_check, share_family_context · Public sink: skill_check, share_family_context.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: skill_check, share_family_context · Public sink: skill_check, share_family_context

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
